clue.text: City physicist finally splitting subatomic particle

indicators.note: the last letter of physicist splits the particle's name, so it goes inside it

parts.note: a boson is a subatomic particle, such as the photon or the Higgs

indicators.note: finally picks out the closing letter of physicist

explanation.surface: A scientist is the last to break apart a tiny particle.
explanation.definitionFit: Boston is the capital of Massachusetts, a major American city.

clue.text: City auditor's cushion on the ground?

indicators.note: an auditor is a listener, so this is how the words sound

parts.note: a buffer is a cushion, and on the ground is low

explanation.surface: An accountant asks whether a pillow should go on the floor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'auditor' is a listener here, not an accountant.
explanation.definitionFit: Buffalo is a city in New York State near Niagara Falls.

clue.text: City festivals coming up

indicators.note: coming up in a down clue means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a mela is a Hindu fair or festival

explanation.surface: A city has festivals on the way.
explanation.definitionFit: Salem is a city in Massachusetts famous for its witch trials, and the capital of Oregon.

clue.text: Part of church lost for a long time

indicators.note: lost means astray, so the letters wander into a new order

explanation.surface: Part of a church went missing for many years.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lost' rearranges FORALONG; 'time' gives the final T.
explanation.definitionFit: The organ loft is the gallery in a church where the organ stands.

clue.text: City speed is beyond me

indicators.note: beyond says the speed and is come after me in the answer

parts.note: MPH, miles per hour, is a measure of speed

explanation.surface: Someone complains that the pace of things is too much for them.
explanation.definitionFit: Memphis is a city in Tennessee, home of Graceland.

clue.text: Nice house around back of cardboard city

indicators.note: around says the house surrounds the letter from cardboard

parts.note: maison is French for house, as spoken in Nice

indicators.note: back of picks the last letter of cardboard

explanation.surface: A pleasant home is wrapped around a shanty town of cardboard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nice' is the French city, not 'pleasant', so the house is French.
explanation.definitionFit: Madison is the state capital of Wisconsin.

clue.text: Take off soprano part on opening of Carmen

indicators.note: in a down clue, on puts the role on top of the letter from Carmen

parts.note: Mimi is the soprano heroine of Puccini's La Boheme

indicators.note: opening of picks the first letter of Carmen

explanation.surface: A soprano leaves her role at the first night of Carmen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Take off' is the verb to imitate, not to depart.
explanation.definitionFit: To take someone off is to impersonate them, a mimic's craft.

clue.text: Chart right, so wrong in the morning

indicators.note: wrong means not in proper order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a.m. marks times in the morning

explanation.surface: Someone discovers a chart was right, then wrong by morning.
explanation.definitionFit: A histogram is a bar chart showing frequencies.

clue.text: Guys about right as drifters?

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the guys go round the letter for right

parts.note: guys and stays are both ropes bracing a mast or tent

explanation.surface: A group of men wonder whether they are aimless wanderers.
explanation.definitionFit: Strays are animals or people who wander from home, much as drifters do.

clue.text: City singer

definitions.meaning: John, the American country singer of Take Me Home, Country Roads

explanation.definitionFit: The Colorado capital shares its name with country singer John.

clue.text: One with great desire going after detailed stuff, delicately formed

indicators.note: going after places one and great desire behind the shortened stuff
de-tailed: the word for stuff loses its final letter

parts.note: to stuff is to fill
I is the Roman numeral for one
greed is a great desire for more

explanation.surface: A greedy person pursues fine, detailed work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detailed' looks like 'intricate', but it means FILL with its tail cut off, giving FIL.
explanation.definitionFit: Filigree is fine ornamental metalwork, so something filigreed is delicately wrought.

clue.text: Bloke spending nought, ultimately?

indicators.note: spending means giving up, so a letter is taken out of the bloke

parts.note: a bloke, an everyday British word for a man, is a mister

indicators.note: ultimately points to the closing letter of nought

explanation.surface: A man who never spends a penny.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is also the definition: a skinflint is a man who spends nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A skinflint who hoards money and spends none is the classic tightwad.

clue.text: A racket inspiring head of mafia organisation

indicators.note: inspiring, breathing in, means the racket takes a letter inside it

parts.note: a din is a loud racket

indicators.note: head of picks the first letter of mafia

explanation.surface: A criminal scheme brings in a mob boss.
explanation.definitionFit: Admin, short for administration, is the organising side of running something.

clue.text: Surgery ends in the clinic with extensive bandaging — gosh!

indicators.note: bandaging means wrapping round, so the big word goes around the clinic's ends

parts.note: vast means extensive

indicators.note: ends in picks the last letters of the two words that follow

parts.note: oh my is an exclamation like gosh

explanation.surface: A patient is heavily bandaged after a clinic operation and exclaims in surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: A vasectomy is a minor operation for male sterilisation.

clue.text: Open-air better, on the other hand

parts.note: to better someone is to outdo them
or introduces an alternative, as on the other hand does

explanation.surface: Someone weighs whether fresh air would be the better option.
explanation.definitionFit: Outdoor and open-air both describe things done outside rather than under a roof.

clue.text: Initially, terrible judgement about state moving slowly

indicators.note: Initially picks the first letter of terrible
about means the judgement goes around the state

parts.note: a ruling is a judgement
ND is the abbreviation for North Dakota, a US state

explanation.surface: A dreadful court ruling about a state is slow to arrive.
explanation.definitionFit: To trundle is to roll along slowly and heavily.

clue.text: Strange chest for city

parts.note: something new is unfamiliar, strange
an ark is a chest or box, as in the Ark of the Covenant

explanation.surface: An odd box is swapped for a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Newark is a city in New Jersey, also a town in England.

clue.text: Formerly outstanding openers going in , two wickets later out for ducks?

indicators.note: out means out of place, so all the letters are rearranged
openers takes the first letters of formerly and outstanding

parts.note: W is the cricket abbreviation for wicket, so two of them give WW

explanation.surface: A cricket side's star openers go in, then two wickets fall and batsmen are out for ducks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going in' reads like batsmen walking out, but here it only says the openers' letters join the mix. A duck is a score of nought in cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: Ducks are an example of waterfowl, birds living on water; the question mark flags definition by example.

clue.text: City a dollar?

parts.note: tin is slang for money, so a dollar is a piece of American tin; the question mark flags the loose sense

explanation.surface: A bare query about a city and a dollar.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'a dollar' as A plus US TIN: tin is slang for cash, so a dollar is American tin.
explanation.definitionFit: Austin is the state capital of Texas.

clue.text: Irish victory accepted by relative leader in Anthony Eden

indicators.note: accepted by means taken in by, so the other letters go inside

parts.note: nan is a grandmother, a relative

indicators.note: leader in picks the first letter of Anthony

explanation.surface: An Irish win is welcomed by a relative of Prime Minister Anthony Eden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Anthony Eden' reads as the British Prime Minister, but 'Eden' alone is the paradise.
explanation.definitionFit: Eden, the garden of perfect bliss, is a paradise, like the Buddhist state of enlightened release.

clue.text: Lady hunter aims, their odds not looking good?

indicators.note: something not looking good is out of shape, so the letters are rearranged
odds picks the first, third and fifth letters of their

explanation.surface: A huntress takes aim, but her chances look poor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'odds' takes TER from 'their'; 'not looking good' rearranges AIMS plus TER.
explanation.definitionFit: Artemis is the Greek goddess of the hunt, a female hunter of myth.

clue.text: Daisy wants me out of the country, ban finally secured

indicators.note: secured means held inside, so the letter from ban is taken in
out of means the word me leaves the country's name

parts.note: America is the country

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of ban

explanation.surface: Someone named Daisy wants a person deported, with a ban in place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of' removes ME from AMERICA, leaving ARICA.
explanation.definitionFit: Arnica is a plant of the daisy family, used in herbal remedies for bruising.

clue.text: Last letter required to fill old puzzle, flipping bitter!

indicators.note: flipping means turning over, so the whole is read in reverse
to fill means the letter goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: a rebus is a picture puzzle
Z is the last letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: A frustrated solver needs the last letter to finish an old puzzle and swears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flipping' looks like a mild swear word but reverses OREZBUS; 'bitter' is about cold weather, not mood.
explanation.definitionFit: Bitter weather is extremely cold, below freezing point.

clue.text: Brief tactic to overcome a state

indicators.note: in a down clue, to overcome puts the shortened tactic above the a
brief means cut short, so the tactic loses its last letter

parts.note: a gambit is an opening tactic

explanation.surface: A short-lived tactic is used to defeat a nation.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gambia is a small West African country, a sovereign state.

clue.text: Ball player from 1966 about to block star

indicators.note: about means around, so the footballer's first name surrounds the blocking word

parts.note: Alan Ball played in England's 1966 World Cup-winning football team
to debar is to block or exclude

explanation.surface: A footballer from the 1966 World Cup is about to stop a star player.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ball' is a surname here, not a sphere: Alan Ball won the World Cup with England in 1966.
explanation.definitionFit: Aldebaran is the bright red star in the constellation Taurus.

clue.text: Pronounced blemish develops

indicators.note: pronounced means spoken, so the answer sounds like the word for a blemish

parts.note: a bruise is a mark or blemish on the skin or fruit

explanation.surface: A conspicuous mark appears on the skin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pronounced' looks like 'noticeable', but it signals speech.
explanation.definitionFit: Trouble that brews is building up, gathering force like a storm.

clue.text: Doctor behind huge beast dropping in lozenge

indicators.note: behind places the doctor after the shortened beast
dropping means losing, so the word in is taken out of the beast

parts.note: a rhino is a huge beast
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A vet stands behind a rhino that is swallowing a throat sweet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dropping' takes IN out of RHINO, leaving RHO.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhomb, or rhombus, is the diamond shape also called a lozenge.

clue.text: City centres in Hoboken, Bamako and Peshawar

indicators.note: centres in picks the middle letters of each of the three place names

explanation.surface: A list of city centres in three towns around the world.
explanation.definitionFit: Omaha is the largest city in Nebraska.

clue.text: First on back row missing capital city

indicators.note: First on picks the opening letter of back
missing capital means losing the leading letter

parts.note: a row is a noisy disturbance, so noise

explanation.surface: A capital city is absent from the back row of a seating plan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing capital' takes the first letter off NOISE, leaving OISE.
explanation.definitionFit: Boise is the state capital of Idaho.

clue.text: Silver in an assignment for city

indicators.note: in places the silver inside the other pieces

parts.note: a chore is a task or assignment
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Silver features in a job set for a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Anchorage is the largest city in Alaska.

clue.text: Great, a city

parts.note: august means grand, great and dignified

explanation.surface: Someone enthuses that a city is great.
explanation.definitionFit: Augusta is the state capital of Maine and a city in Georgia known for golf.

clue.text: City in Laos, a pleasure to recall

indicators.note: to recall says the hidden letters are read backwards
in says the letters sit inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A city in Laos is fondly remembered.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft left 'in' as a link word, but it is what signals that the letters are concealed within 'Laos, a pleasure'; 'to recall' then turns them backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: El Paso is a city in Texas on the Mexican border.
